units.source_en: After the party rested briefly at Numazu Castle, Ieyasu went to the bedside of the ailing Ōkubo Tadasuke.

units.source_en: Tadasuke was past seventy and so feeble with age that he could scarcely sit up; moreover, he had no child to succeed him.
units.source_zh: 忠佐年逾七旬，已然衰老得很难坐起，膝下亦荒凉无子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一行人在沼津城小憩后，家康到病中的大久保忠佐榻前探望。忠佐年逾七旬，已然衰老得很难坐起，膝下亦荒凉无子。

paragraphs.source_en: The party then proceeded to Mishima, where they received a secret report that “unease is spreading through the household of Ōkubo Tadachika in Odawara.” It was said that, after the affair of Ōkubo Nagayasu, the retainers feared that the Honda father and son would plot against them, creating an extraordinary atmosphere.

units.source_en: The party then proceeded to Mishima, where they received a secret report that “unease is spreading through the household of Ōkubo Tadachika in Odawara.”
units.source_zh: 然后，一行人前往三岛，在那里，接到了“小田原的大久保忠邻家中有不安之气”的密报。

units.source_en: It was said that, after the affair of Ōkubo Nagayasu, the retainers feared that the Honda father and son would plot against them, creating an extraordinary atmosphere.

ja.t: れられるのではないかと

units.source_zh: 据云，由于大久保长安事发，家臣担心会被本多父子算计，气氛异常。

paragraphs.source_zh: 然后，一行人前往三岛，在那里，接到了“小田原的大久保忠邻家中有不安之气”的密报。据云，由于大久保长安事发，家臣担心会被本多父子算计，气氛异常。

paragraphs.source_en: “The waves appear higher than I imagined.” Ieyasu said this only to Mataemon and told Honda Masazumi, who was traveling with them, nothing at all.

units.source_en: “The waves appear higher than I imagined.”
units.source_zh: “风浪似比想象的还要大啊。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu said this only to Mataemon and told Honda Masazumi, who was traveling with them, nothing at all.
units.source_zh: 家康只是对又右卫门这般道，对同行的本多正纯则缄口不言。

paragraphs.source_zh: “风浪似比想象的还要大啊。”家康只是对又右卫门这般道，对同行的本多正纯则缄口不言。

paragraphs.source_en: After staying one day in Mishima, the party paid homage at the Myōjin shrine the following day. A close retainer then suggested falconry, but Ieyasu’s mind was elsewhere; he was nothing like his former self.

units.source_en: After staying one day in Mishima, the party paid homage at the Myōjin shrine the following day.
units.source_zh: 在三岛停了一日，翌日，一行参谒了明神社。

units.source_en: A close retainer then suggested falconry, but Ieyasu’s mind was elsewhere; he was nothing like his former self.
units.source_zh: 然后有近臣建议放鹰，家康却心不在焉，完全不似先前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在三岛停了一日，翌日，一行参谒了明神社。然后有近臣建议放鹰，家康却心不在焉，完全不似先前。

paragraphs.source_en: Mataemon wondered how far the realm would fall into chaos if Lord Ieyasu died before this matter was settled.

units.source_en: Mataemon wondered how far the realm would fall into chaos if Lord Ieyasu died before this matter was settled.
units.source_zh: 又右卫门寻思，若此事不得解决，家康公就归天，不知天下将乱至何样。

paragraphs.source_zh: 又右卫门寻思，若此事不得解决，家康公就归天，不知天下将乱至何样。

paragraphs.source_en: After they passed the Hakone checkpoint and Odawara came into view, a sudden unease seized Mataemon: Ieyasu’s health was steadily failing, and just when, at the end of his life, he was about to close his eyes with confidence and contentment, this had occurred. The magnitude of the blow was beyond ordinary imagining.

units.source_en: After they passed the Hakone checkpoint and Odawara came into view, a sudden unease seized Mataemon: Ieyasu’s health was steadily failing, and just when, at the end of his life, he was about to close his eyes with confidence and contentment, this had occurred. The magnitude of the blow was beyond ordinary imagining.
units.source_zh: 经过箱根的关所后，眼前出现了小田原，又右卫门心中突然感到一阵不安：家康身子越来越差，在人生之末，正要带着自信，满足地闭上眼睛时，却发生了这等事，打击之巨，实非常人可想象。

paragraphs.source_zh: 经过箱根的关所后，眼前出现了小田原，又右卫门心中突然感到一阵不安：家康身子越来越差，在人生之末，正要带着自信，满足地闭上眼睛时，却发生了这等事，打击之巨，实非常人可想象。

paragraphs.source_en: Mataemon never strayed so much as half a step from Ieyasu’s palanquin. Yet Ieyasu often sank into deep thought, as though he had forgotten everything around him…

units.source_en: Mataemon never strayed so much as half a step from Ieyasu’s palanquin.
units.source_zh: 又右卫门始终不离家康的轿子半步。

units.source_en: Yet Ieyasu often sank into deep thought, as though he had forgotten everything around him…

ja.t: れてしまったかのようだった……

units.source_zh: 然而家康时常陷入沉思，似忘记了周遭诸事……

paragraphs.source_zh: 又右卫门始终不离家康的轿子半步。然而家康时常陷入沉思，似忘记了周遭诸事……
